verdict.rationale: Mistral is an API provider, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair ask. The pack contains no documentation of one. The probe found all four candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths returning 404. The llms.txt index and the List Models endpoint are adjacent machine-readable resources, not an API specification, so they earn no credit. Confidence is medium because the probe checked only a few common paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
